race.comment: CABALETTO (6) is the immediate danger after a sharp third at this track when beaten just over a length, and her 1000m record is reliable enough to keep her high in calculations. OOHLALOUVRE (3) brings the best local consistency, winning a BM65 here as favourite after a narrow CL4 second. Inside draw helps but she'll need to raise the bar again. WOOTTON YOU KNOW (12) returns and will be hoping to replicate his dominant first-up win here last campaign when shedding the maiden tag. No lead-up work leaves him a touch tricky to get a hold on but the talent seems to be there. BLAKEMORE AVENUE (2) has been freshened and drops back a couple rungs. Improvement anticipated.
